name: AdKit - Ads Manager
description:
AdKit connects your ad accounts to Claude so you can run advertising in plain language. It works with Meta (Facebook & Instagram), Google, TikTok, LinkedIn, Reddit, Microsoft (Bing), and X (Twitter) Ads.

Ask for performance reporting, ROAS reports, and ad analytics with date, placement, and demographic breakdowns. Audit PPC budgets and ad spend. Create and edit campaigns as drafts. See what your competitors run in a library of 500k+ ads. Every change starts as a draft and publishes only after you approve it, so Claude never touches a live campaign on its own.

Built for agencies and in-house marketing teams.

_published_faq.name: How do I add AdKit - Ads Manager to Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor?

acceptedAnswer.text: Add AdKit - Ads Manager to Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor by connecting its remote MCP URL in each client's MCP settings. In Claude, add a custom connector. In ChatGPT, add an MCP app. In Cursor, add an MCP server under Settings. The MCP URL is https://mcp.adkit.so/api/mcp/core. This server requires OAuth, so complete the login prompt after you connect.

_published_faq.name: What tools does the AdKit - Ads Manager MCP server provide?

acceptedAnswer.text: AdKit - Ads Manager provides these MCP tools: adkit_checkin, adkit_feedback, adkit_library, adkit_manage, adkit_projects, adkit_setup, and adkit_status.

_published_faq.name: What are the best alternatives to AdKit - Ads Manager?

acceptedAnswer.text: As of October 17, 2026, alternatives to AdKit - Ads Manager in sales-and-marketing on the Manufact MCP catalog include Griddo AX Docs, Rocket Sloth, Affonso.io, Datacircle, and Tolt.

_published_faq.name: Does AdKit - Ads Manager MCP require authentication?

acceptedAnswer.text: AdKit - Ads Manager requires authentication. Connect it in Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor and complete the OAuth login prompt.
AdKit - Ads Manager is developed by AdKit. It is listed as community on the Claude connector directory.
